name: Simplenote
description_en:
Simplenote is a free, account-based text-note service with automatic sync, tags, search, Markdown and per-note sharing. It offers web, mobile and desktop clients, with offline editing after notes have been downloaded. It does not provide uploaded attachments or a no-account local mode.

Its deliberately narrow text workflow is useful for lightweight lists and reference notes. The official help explicitly distinguishes encryption during network transfer from unencrypted-at-rest note storage, making privacy fit an important selection condition.
description_zh:
Simplenote 是免费的账户式文字笔记服务，提供自动同步、标签、搜索、Markdown 与单篇共享，包含 Web、移动和桌面客户端，下载笔记后可离线编辑。它不提供附件上传，也没有无需账户的本地模式。

这种有明确边界的文字工作流适合轻量清单与参考笔记。官方帮助明确区分网络传输加密与笔记未静态加密，因此隐私适配是重要选型条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Write text notes, checklists and Markdown without file attachments.
core_features.explanation_zh: 书写文字笔记、清单与 Markdown，不支持文件附件。

core_features.explanation_en: Invite accounts to edit a note or separately publish a view-only link.
core_features.explanation_zh: 邀请账户编辑单篇笔记，或另行发布只读链接。

core_features.explanation_en: Use note history and Trash; export unsynced work before sync repair.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用笔记历史与废纸篓，同步修复前导出未同步内容。

en: Maintain a text checklist across devices.
zh: 跨设备维护文字检查清单。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Hosted account sync with open-source clients; self-hosted server not established.
Deployment.zh: 托管账户同步与开源客户端；未确认自行托管服务端。

steps.en: Create an account, sign in and download notes before expecting offline access.
steps.zh: 创建账户、登录并下载笔记后，再使用离线功能。

steps.en: Create a tagged text note and verify collaborator or published-link permissions.
steps.zh: 创建带标签文字笔记，核对协作者或发布链接权限。

steps.en: Export a representative library before importing or repairing sync.
steps.zh: 导入或修复同步前，导出代表性资料库。

items.en: For missing text, official guidance starts with note history, including blank/duplicate notes, then Trash. For a sync problem, check that all devices use the same account and inspect the web copy; export unsynced notes before logging out if the server copy is not correct. This is more specific than simply reinstalling. Closing the account permanently deletes its notes, so export first. No actual loss, restore or multi-device conflict was tested here.
items.zh: 文字丢失时，官方先建议检查笔记历史，包括空白／重复笔记，再查看废纸篓。同步问题应确认设备使用同一账户，检查网页副本；服务器副本不正确时，退出前先导出未同步笔记。这比直接重装更具体。关闭账户会永久删除笔记，因此需先导出。本次未实际测试丢失、恢复或多设备冲突。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Apps, sync, sharing and backups described as free; not a paid-plan trial.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 应用、同步、共享与备份说明为免费，不是付费套餐试用。

sections.title_zh: 跨设备维护同一文字笔记
sections.en: For an illustrative shared checklist, create a note, add a topic tag, enable Markdown if needed and invite another Simplenote account through the collaboration panel. Sharing must be set per note; multiple notes cannot be shared in one operation. A published view-only link is different: everyone holding it can read the content. Images may be referenced by an externally hosted Markdown URL, but files and PDFs cannot be uploaded as note attachments.
sections.zh: 例如共享检查清单可创建笔记、添加主题标签、按需启用 Markdown，再通过协作面板邀请另一 Simplenote 账户。共享需逐篇设置，不能一次共享多篇。发布只读链接则不同：持有链接者都能阅读。图片可用 Markdown 引用外部托管网址，但不能把文件和 PDF 上传为笔记附件。

sections.title_en: Download first and avoid duplicate imports
sections.title_zh: 先下载，再防范重复导入
sections.en: Offline apps need an earlier sign-in and download; changes sync after reconnecting. A normal unopened web tab is not available offline; the help describes installing a PWA beforehand. Import supports plain text/Markdown and Simplenote exports; ENEX is desktop-only. Imports create new notes without merging changes or suppressing duplicates. Mac import/export requires the Electron build, rather than assuming the App Store app has identical support.
sections.zh: 离线应用需要事先登录并下载笔记，重新联网后再同步修改。普通未打开的网页标签离线不可用；帮助说明可提前安装 PWA。导入支持纯文字／Markdown 和 Simplenote 导出，ENEX 仅桌面支持。导入会创建新笔记，不合并修改，也不自动忽略重复。Mac 导入／导出需要 Electron 构建，不能默认 App Store 应用完全相同。

sections.title_en: History, Trash and a safe sync repair
sections.title_zh: 历史、废纸篓与安全同步修复
sections.en: For missing text, official guidance starts with note history, including blank/duplicate notes, then Trash. For a sync problem, check that all devices use the same account and inspect the web copy; export unsynced notes before logging out if the server copy is not correct. This is more specific than simply reinstalling. Closing the account permanently deletes its notes, so export first. No actual loss, restore or multi-device conflict was tested here.
sections.zh: 文字丢失时，官方先建议检查笔记历史，包括空白／重复笔记，再查看废纸篓。同步问题应确认设备使用同一账户，检查网页副本；服务器副本不正确时，退出前先导出未同步笔记。这比直接重装更具体。关闭账户会永久删除笔记，因此需先导出。本次未实际测试丢失、恢复或多设备冲突。

sections.title_en: Free clients do not make a private vault
sections.title_zh: 免费客户端不等于私密保险库
sections.en: The service says apps, sync, sharing and backups are free, not a time-limited trial. Official developer documentation links open-source clients; the Electron licence read is GPLv2. That does not establish a self-hostable production sync backend. Help says notes are encrypted in transit but not at rest and discourages sensitive secrets. Choose it for lightweight text if those conditions fit, rather than treating an account login as end-to-end encryption.
sections.zh: 官网说明应用、同步、共享与备份免费，而非限时试用。官方开发者文档链接开源客户端，读取的 Electron 许可为 GPLv2；这不证明有可自行托管的生产同步服务端。帮助说明笔记传输加密、静态不加密，并不建议保存敏感秘密。适合在这些条件可接受时做轻量文字记录，不能把账户登录当作端到端加密。

research_gaps.en: No sync, loss/recovery, sharing or import test was run; current server deployment and all component licences were not examined.
research_gaps.zh: 未运行同步、丢失／恢复、共享或导入测试；未检查当前服务端部署及全部组件许可。
